verses.ar:
كُلُّ الْقُلُوبِ إِلَى الْحَبِيبِ تَمِيلُ ۞ وَمَعِي بِذٰلِكَ شَاهِدٌ وَدَلِيلُ
أَمَّا الدَّلِيلُ إِذَا ذَكَرْتُ مُحَمَّدًا ۞ صَارَتْ دُمُوعُ الْعَاشِقِينَ تَسِيلُ
هٰذَا رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ هٰذَا الْمُصْطَفَى ۞ هٰذَا لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ خَلِيلُ
verses.tr:
Kullu-l-qulūbi ila-l-ḥabībi tamīlu · wa maʿī bi-dhālika shāhidun wa dalīlu
Amma-d-dalīlu idhā dhakartu Muḥammadan · ṣārat dumūʿu-l-ʿāshiqīna tasīlu
Hādhā Rasūlu-llāhi hādha-l-Muṣṭafā · hādhā li-Rabbi-l-ʿālamīna khalīlu
verses.en:
Every heart melts in the rapture of the beloved, and for that love I have a witness, a witness and a proof:
Regarding that proof, if I mention the name of Muhammad, the eyes of the lovers will be overrun with tears
He is the Messenger of God, He is the Chosen One, He is, to the Lord, a most trusted friend

verses.ar:
الْمَدَدْ الْمَدَدْ الْمَدَدْ
الْمَدَدْ يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهْ
الْمَدَدْ الْمَدَدْ الْمَدَدْ
الْمَدَدْ يَا حَبِيبَ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr:
Al-madad al-madad al-madad
Al-madad yā Rasūla-llāh
Al-madad al-madad al-madad
Al-madad yā Ḥabība-llāh
verses.en:
Aid us, help us
Support us, O God's Messenger!
Aid us, help us
Support us, O Most Beloved of God!

verses.ar:
رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ مُجْتَمَعْنَا ۞ غَايَتُهُ حُسْنُ الْخِتَامْ
وَأَكْرِمِ الْأَرْوَاحَ مِنَّا ۞ بِلِقَا خَيْرِ الْأَنَامْ
verses.tr:
Rabbi wa-jʿal mujtamaʿnā · ghāyatuhu ḥusnu-l-khitām
Wa akrimi-l-arwāḥa minnā · bi-liqā khayri-l-anām
verses.en:
O Lord, grant our gathering a joyous purpose and conclusion
And bless all souls among us to meet the Pearl of Your Creation

verses.ar:
رَبِّ إِنَّا قَدْ دَعَوْنَا ۞ أَعْطِنَا مَا قَدْ رَجَوْنَا
هَبْ لَنَا فِي الدِّينِ عَوْنَا ۞ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ
verses.tr:
Rabbi innā qad daʿawnā · aʿṭinā mā qad rajawnā
Hab lanā fi-d-dīni ʿawnā · bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʿalā Muḥammad
verses.en:
O our Lord, we're calling upon You, and we seek that which pleases You
Grant us for our journey Your aid, by the blessings upon Muhammad

verses.ar:
سِيدِي صَاحِبَ الْحَضْرَةْ ۞ أَكْرِمْنَا مِنْكَ بِنَظْرَةْ
سِيدِي يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَا ۞ وَالْقَاسِمْ وَعَبْدِ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr:
Sīdī ṣāḥiba-l-ḥaḍrah · akrimnā minka bi-naẓrah
Sīdī yā aba-z-Zahrā · wa-l-Qāsim wa ʿAbdi-llāh
verses.en:
O treasured friend of the Divine, honour us by looking once upon us!
Our master, father of Fatima Zahra, and of Qasim and Abd-Allah!

verses.ar:
سِيدِي أَنْتَ الْحَبِيبْ ۞ بِذِكْرِكْ قَلْبِي يَطِيبْ
سِيدِي حَاشَا يَخِيبْ ۞ مَنْ لَاذَ بِرَسُولِ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr:
Sīdī anta-l-ḥabīb · bi-dhikrik qalbī yaṭīb
Sīdī ḥāshā yakhīb · man lādha bi-Rasūli-llāh
verses.en:
Our master, you are the Beloved; with your remembrance my heart is healed!
O my master! One who takes refuge will never lose with the Messenger of God!

verses.ar:
سِيدِي أَنْتَ الْمُخْتَارْ ۞ بِمَدْحِكْ تُجْلَى الْأَقْدَارْ
سِيدِي أَجِرْنَا مِنَ النَّارْ ۞ بِجَاهِكْ يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr:
Sīdī anta-l-Mukhtār · bi-madḥik tujla-l-aqdār
Sīdī ajirnā mina-n-nār · bi-jāhik yā Rasūla-llāh
verses.en:
O master, you are the Chosen One; in praising you our destinies become clear
O master, save us from the fire, for your sake, O God's Messenger

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ بِهِمْ وَبِآلِهِمِ ۞ عَجِّلْ بِالنَّصْرِ وَبِالْفَرَجِ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi bihim wa bi-ālihimi · ʿajjil bi-n-naṣri wa bi-l-faraji
verses.en: O Lord, we ask You by the beloved and his family: grant us a speedy victory and spiritual openings!

verses.ar: وَارْحَمْ يَا أَكْرَمَ مَنْ رَحِمَا ۞ عَبْدًا عَنْ بَابِكَ لَمْ يَعُجِ
verses.tr: Wa-rḥam yā akrama man raḥimā · ʿabdan ʿan bābika lam yaʿuji
verses.en: O Most Merciful One, who is generous with His mercy: a poor servant at Your door will never be refused!

verses.ar: وَاخْتِمْ عَمَلِي بِخَوَاتِمِهَا ۞ لِأَكُونَ غَدًا فِي الْحَشْرِ نَجِي
verses.tr: Wa-khtim ʿamalī bi-khawātimihā · li-akūna ghadan fi-l-ḥashri najī
verses.en: And make my life's deeds to be of virtuous result, so on that Day I come before You my soul may be in peace!

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بِكَ ضَاقَ الْأَمْرُ فَقُلْ ۞ اشْتَدِّي أَزْمَةُ تَنْفَرِجِي
verses.tr: Wa idhā bika ḍāqa-l-amru fa-qul · ishtaddī azmatu tanfariji
verses.en: O friends, if you ever feel hopeless in your life's situation, say: "With every burden comes a divine opening!"
